about_the_game:
New Heaven is a fast-paced, wave-based zombie shooter built around risk, progression, and constant escalation.

Between runs, you return to a central lobby where long-term progression happens. From there, you choose your next destination, prepare your build, and dive back into the apocalypse.

Every run is a balance between short-term survival and long-term growth.

Two Currencies, Two Purposes

  • Zombie Blood
    Earned during a run by killing zombies.
    Used to buy weapons and upgrades during the round.
    This currency resets after every run, forcing you to adapt and make smart choices under pressure.

  • Cash
    Also earned by killing zombies, but permanently saved.
    Used in the lobby to unlock upgrades, perks, and new systems that carry over between runs.

This system creates a constant tension between surviving the current wave and investing in future runs.

Lobby Progression

The lobby is your safe zone and long-term progression hub. Here you can:

  • Permanently upgrade perks and weapons

  • Unlock new weapon buying stations that can appear in future maps

  • Prepare for harder destinations by strengthening your overall power

Every upgrade makes future runs more manageable — but never easy.

Destinations & Difficulty

Not all locations are equal.

Maps are divided by difficulty, with tougher destinations offering greater challenges and higher rewards. Stronger enemies, faster waves, and more intense combat await those who dare to push further.

Choosing the right destination is key to survival and progression.

Core Features

  • Wave-Based Zombie Combat with escalating difficulty

  • Permanent Lobby Progression through perks, weapons, and unlocks

  • Risk-Based Currency System that rewards skill and smart decisions

  • Multiple Maps divided by difficulty

  • Fast, Arcade-Style FPS Gameplay

  • Stylized Low-Poly Visuals focused on clarity and action

content_descriptors.notes: this game contain cartoon blood and demon and the story is related to satan.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: intel i5 8400 or Ryzen 2600/x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: gtx 750 ti or amd R7 260
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: gtx 1660 or Radeon RX 590
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
